# Gimmir

> Gimmir is two founders, Nazar Moroz and Oleh Palazhii, who build SaaS products their clients own outright: code, accounts, IP and roadmap in the client's name from the first commit. Nine products shipped, four of them in fitness, where we go deepest. Gimmir LLC is a Delaware (US) company; the team works from the EU.

We work with two kinds of clients:

- Franchise HQs: franchisors with 3+ units (studios, clubs, schools) in the UK and Ireland, in fitness and kids' activities. We build the HQ its own member app, booking and payments. The HQ earns a monthly tech fee from every franchisee plus a fee on every member payment. £12,000 fixed set-up, ready in 12 weeks, 3 founding partner slots.
- Founders: business owners with a business or an audience who want to turn it into a SaaS product they own. We did it for ourselves first, with Jimmy Coach.

Wellness, yes; regulated clinical products, no.

## Case studies

- [UN1T](https://gimmir.com/work/un1t): a 10-studio fitness franchise with 3,000+ members and its own app on the App Store. Oleh led the architecture.
- [Jimmy Coach](https://gimmir.com/work/jimmy-coach): an online coaching app Nazar co-founded with Quentin Randis, a Hyrox and CrossFit coach, and one we co-own: one iOS and Android app and a web dashboard, with more than $12,000 a month in recurring revenue.
